_comment: Curated real venues for Obsidian Capital sales meetings. Indexed by territory and activity.
_stadiums_comment: Namespaced per league — MLB/NBA/NFL team codes collide (LAC is both the Clippers and the Chargers), so lookups must go through stadiums.<league>.<code>, never a flat dict.

LAC.name: Intuit Dome
